items.title: Graph neural networks for molecular property prediction in drug discovery: a 2025 benchmark
items.abstractText: We benchmark graph neural network architectures for molecular property prediction across drug discovery datasets, covering solubility, toxicity and bioactivity endpoints.

items.title: GNN-based molecular property models for drug discovery pipelines
items.abstractText: We integrate GNN-based molecular property models into drug discovery pipelines and evaluate them on absorption and toxicity endpoints.
